title: Keyboard Input Tool — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Sends keyboard input to authorized applications, accurately and safely. The Keyboard Input Tool types text and sends key combinations to authorized applications. It supports plain text entry, special keys (Enter, Tab, arrows), and modifier chords (Ctrl+C style), with configurable typing speed so fast applications never drop characters. Every keystroke goes only to the approved target window.
capabilities: Type plain and Unicode text into authorized targets
Send special keys and modifier chords
Adjustable inter-key delay for reliability
Type-then-verify mode for critical fields
Full audit log of sent keystrokes
